newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: U.S. puts Malaysia end-June palm stock at 700,000t.
newsitem.headline: U.S. puts Malaysia end-June palm stock at 700,000t.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil stocks are expected to be around 700,000 tonnes at end-June 1997 from a revised 774,000 tonnes at end-June in 1996, the U.S. embassy said in a monthly report

"With anticipated increases in overseas demand in the next few months, the palm oil stock level is expected to hover around the 700,000 tonnes level during the April-June period," the U.S. Department of Agriculture report released by the embassy said. It did not give an estimate for end-May stocks. But local traders estimated end-May stocks at around 745,000 tonnes.
The report also said production in the April-June was estimated at 2.07 million tonnes against 2.06 million tonnes in the same period of 1996.
"A seasonal uptrend has begun and the industry is expecting crude palm oil production to increase around five to six percent during May," it said.
Malaysian crop forecaster Ivan Wong last week projected output in May would rise seven percent to 784,000 tonnes over April. -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom - 275-6834 -
